title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1967-05-05
source: Don Wolfe's 3.75 ips > Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard source of a beloved early ’67 show, featuring free, loose playing and an early Jerry Gibson performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise this recording as an upgrade over earlier releases – correct track order, reduced noise‑reduction and proper pitch on “New Potato Caboose” and “Hard to Handle”. The musical performance is described as one of the all‑time favorites: loose, free and excellent, with a possible early glimpse of Jerry Garcia on his Gibson. Overall the tape sounds clean for its era and captures the joyous spirit of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments about both the performance (all‑time favorite, free & excellent playing) and the technical upgrade; soundboard source with clear improvements yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tracks in correct order, less aggressive noise reduction, pitch corrected on key tracks, overall clean and balanced sound for a 1967 tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list commentary, but reviewers describe the show as free, loose and excellent, indicating a relaxed, flowing performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Possibly the earliest recording of Jerry on his Gibson; playing described as free, loose and excellent.
